property_summary: The owner is set by the constructor; the onlyOwner modifier should require that msg.sender equals owner. The buggy version always reverts because it compares against address(0). A non-owner call to setOwner should revert in the reference but the buggy version also reverts; instead we test that the reference allows a call by the actual owner (the test contract) to setOwner, while the buggy version reverts it.
